_comment: Curated SWGOH meta-teams database consumed by tools/analyze_roster.py. base_id values match swgoh.gg export ids. TIERS: S (top/meta-defining), A (strong/competitive), B (viable/situational). MODES: gac-def, gac-off, fleet, tw, raid, conquest. This is a SEED — meta is patch-dependent; verify/expand against current tier lists. Units not owned simply report as missing (correct for build-toward teams).

teams.name: Great Mothers Nightsisters
teams.notes: Best non-GL defensive wall in the game. Revive/summon stall punishes attackers on auto.

teams.name: Inquisitors (Grand Inquisitor)
teams.notes: Sticky, confuse/marked synergy. Needs Grand Inquisitor AND Third Sister (Reva) as the leaders to function.

teams.name: Bounty Hunters (Bossk)
teams.notes: Tanky, thermal-detonator pressure. Doubles as Profundity fleet crew (efficient investment).

teams.name: Clones (General Skywalker)
teams.notes: Elite wall WITH General Skywalker (GAS) as leader. Counter/assist chains. Without GAS, use Rex/Echo lead (drops to B).

teams.name: Galactic Republic (Padme)
teams.notes: Stall wall: protection-up, dispels, hard to burst. Forces long fights where attackers bleed units.

teams.name: Mandalorians (Beskar Mando)
teams.notes: Sustain/sticky. Strong when all members are high-relic.

teams.name: Imperial Troopers (Range Trooper)
teams.notes: High burst that punishes greedy attacks.

teams.name: Resistance (Hero Finn)
teams.notes: Assist-spam and self-sustain; hard to kill on auto.

teams.name: Rebels (Commander Luke)
teams.notes: Sticky classic Rebels. Note: GL Leia lead is far stronger if available.

teams.name: GL Leia (Rebels)
teams.notes: Galactic Legend wall. Stealth/culling. Top defensive anchor.

teams.name: GL Rey (Resistance)
teams.notes: Best pure defensive-hold GL. Finish her Ultimate (Tier VI) for full strength.

teams.name: Jedi Master Luke (Jedi)
teams.notes: Best OFFENSIVE GL owned — keep for cracking the enemy's hardest team.

teams.name: Supreme Leader Kylo Ren (First Order)
teams.notes: In-progress 4th GL. Requirement squad mostly R7-9; Sith Trooper needs 7 stars for upper tiers.

teams.name: FLEET: Profundity + Bounty Hunters
teams.notes: Best offensive fleet. Finish Raddus capital abilities (Holdo Maneuver). IG-88 relic limits IG-2000.

teams.name: FLEET: Negotiator (Galactic Republic)
teams.notes: Maxed capital abilities. Strong defensive holder.

teams.name: FLEET: Endurance (Jedi)
teams.notes: Maxed capital abilities. Ready flex / 2nd defensive fleet.

teams.name: Jabba the Hutt (Hutt Cartel) [BUILD-TOWARD]
teams.notes: Top-tier team but requires unlocking Jabba (big journey). Awareness entry.
